scenario.topic: Choose which charity the bake sale proceeds should support
scenario.opening_question: Which charity aligns best with our bake sale goals and values?

options.name: Neighborhood Food Pantry Expansion Fund
options.upside: Directly supports food security for vulnerable families nearby
options.tradeoff: Funds are restricted to pantry expansion, limiting other program support
options.concern: May not address other urgent community needs beyond hunger

options.name: City Youth Arts Scholarship Program
options.upside: Invests in creative education and opportunities for underserved youth
options.tradeoff: Smaller direct community reach compared to basic needs charities
options.concern: Impact may be less visible or immediate to the general public
options.best_for: supporting youth development and arts education

options.name: Local Animal Shelter Medical Care Fund
options.upside: Improves health and adoption rates for homeless pets
options.tradeoff: Does not address human-centered social issues
options.concern: Some may prefer causes that benefit people directly
options.best_for: prioritizing animal welfare and community pet health

options.name: Senior Citizens Home Safety Upgrade Initiative
options.upside: Enhances safety and independence for elderly residents
options.tradeoff: Limited number of beneficiaries due to higher per-home costs
options.concern: May be less appealing to younger community members
options.best_for: supporting aging population’s quality of life

shared_context: The bake sale proceeds total approximately $500
The group consists of exactly 3 participants
The goal is to support a local charity with tangible community impact
